Title: Jiron Form Builder AI
Description:
An optional add-on for Jiron Form Builder on Umbraco 17 that helps editors in the designer through Umbraco.AI.

Features:
- Draft a form with AI from a description, or from the pasted text of a questionnaire.
- Translate with AI: a form's texts into another of the site's languages, side by side before they are applied.
- Suggest help text: a help text and clearer wording for a field, each with its reason.

Everything it writes is a draft for an editor to review: nothing is published, or even saved, until an editor saves it. Nothing a visitor enters ever reaches an AI, and the add-on never sees or stores a key. It works with any Umbraco.AI provider: install one next to it.

Free to use and change, including commercially; no selling, no published versions of your own (free or paid, open source or not), no competing products; source-available.
